sentences.text: It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that during the pendency of the present writ petition, the matter has been referred under Section 3H(4) of the National Highway Act, 1956, for adjudication.
3. In that view of the matter, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw the present writ petition with a liberty to pursue his remedy before the referral court.

5. With the aforesaid liberty, the present writ petition is, hereby, disposed of.
6.
Pending interlocutory application, if any, stands disposed of.
